title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
abstract: arXiv:2611.06607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic research loops that let a language model propose a change, run a fixed experiment and keep whatever improves the metric work well in machine learning. In trading research the same loop is a machine for producing false discoveries: a backtest that "improves the metric" is, by default, overfit, look-ahead, a multiple-comparisons artifact, cost-free, or market drift wearing a strategy. We describe Autonomous Quant Researcher, an open-source loop built on the opposite premise: the model proposes, and only trusted code decides. Proposals are strict declarative JSON over a fixed vocabulary, so there is no model-written code to sandbox. Evaluation runs on immutable chronological stores split into discovery, validation and a final holdout that can be opened exactly once, after a durable receipt is written. Acceptance is a conjunction of absolute gates (positive edge and net P&L after costs, a positive weekly-cluster bootstrap lower bound

translated_title: 难以欺骗：面向量化金融的有界LLM研究循环，以及二十余次实验活动的发现
translated_abstract: 让语言模型提出修改、运行固定实验并保留任何能提升指标结果的方案——这类智能体研究循环在机器学习中行之有效。但在交易研究中，同样的循环却是一台制造虚假发现的机器：默认情况下，一个“提升了指标”的回测要么是过拟合，要么存在前视偏差，要么是多重比较产生的假象，要么忽略了交易成本，要么只是披着策略外衣的市场漂移。我们介绍了 Autonomous Quant Researcher，一个建立在相反前提之上的开源研究循环：模型只负责提出方案，决策权完全交由可信代码。提案必须是基于固定词表的严格声明式JSON，因此不存在需要沙箱隔离的模型生成代码。评估在不可变的时序数据存储上运行，数据被划分为发现集、验证集和一个最终留出集——留出集只能在写入持久化收据之后被打开一次。接受标准是一系列绝对门槛的合取（扣除成本后为正的边际优势与净损益、按周聚类的自助法下界为正……[摘要在此处截断]）
tldr: 该论文提出开源系统"Autonomous Quant Researcher"，让LLM仅能提出声明式JSON提案、由可信代码执行严格评估（不可变数据划分、只能打开一次的留出集和多重绝对接受门槛），从而防止量化交易研究中因智能体循环导致的过拟合与虚假发现。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Autonomous Quant Researcher, an open-source bounded LLM research loop for quantitative finance in which the model only proposes strict declarative JSON changes while trusted code enforces immutable data splits, a one-time holdout, and absolute acceptance gates to prevent overfitting and false discoveries.
